thread:
Anya (Product): Heads-up: Customer X has asked for p99 < 120ms for the embeddings endpoint by their Nov launch. We need runtime + infra + security alignment on hard blockers and ownership. Proposing a 20m triage tomorrow 10:00am PT. Can folks call out the non-negotiables?

Mike (Eng - Runtime): That p99 is doable but tight. Main blockers: continuous batching config, KV-cache cold starts, and model quantization validation for quality. Also need a perf baseline for the exact prompt distribution. Can we do 150ms for GA and 120ms for dedicated?

Sophia (Eng-Infra): For a consistent p99 at ~120ms we need reserved GPUs (dedicated pool), faster NIC config (SR-IOV), and autoscale warmup to avoid cold starts. Network egress and instance boot times are the usual pain. ETA for infra changes ~3 sprints unless we commit reserved capacity now.

Ryan (Security): From security/compliance: Customer X requires KMS-backed keys + audit logs and a SOC2 readiness snapshot. KMS integration + audit plumbing is ~3-4 weeks of dev + review. We can gate GA on dedicated with KMS and do hosted later.

Anya (Product): OK — suggestion: phased launch to balance customer need vs platform risk:

```
Acceptance criteria (proposal):
- Hosted GA: p50 < 50ms, p95 < 90ms, p99 < 150ms
- Dedicated (Early Access): p99 < 120ms + KMS + audit logs
- Canary rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated rollback < 5m
- E2E regressions: prompt set v1.2 passes (quality delta < 1% on eval)
- Infra: reserved pool + warmup policy for dedicated canary
```

This gets Customer X into a path quickly while limiting risk. Thoughts?

Mike (Eng - Runtime): Works for me. Need to validate quantized model quality + run synthetic perf with expected seq lengths. I'll schedule perf runs for this week. Also want an A/B to compare continuous batching on/off.

Sophia (Eng-Infra): I'll open infra tickets for reserved pool + NIC changes and add cost estimate. If product signs the budget we can carve the pool in 2 weeks and have canary infra in 3 weeks.

Ryan (Security): I'll kick off the KMS integration spike and coordinate with compliance. If we do early access on dedicated only, we can parallelize SOC2 readiness but GA will wait.

Anya (Product): Cool. Action items from here:
- Mike: perf runs + quantization eval (this week)
- Sophia: infra tickets + cost (PR by EOW)
- Ryan: KMS spike + compliance checklist (start today)
- Anya: write RFC with the acceptance criteria and schedule 10:00am triage tomorrow.

Mike (Eng - Runtime): adding note — we should test KV-cache priming on warmup path. Cold starts are the biggest source of high p99s.

Sophia (Eng-Infra): Agreed. Will add warmup hooks to the infra ticket.

Ryan (Security): Quick Q: do we need HSM/KMS for dedicated only or hosted too? Product decision affects scope.

Anya (Product): For now: KMS required for Early Access (dedicated). Hosted KMS later. We'll call out timeline in RFC.

DeployBot: Canary rollout policy created: 5% initial traffic, health checks at 30s intervals, auto-rollback on 3 consecutive 5xx.

Anya (Product): Thanks all. Please add any blockers to the RFC thread and paste design links. See you at 10am. :thumbsup:
